conversion:si-brochure/hour-to-second.collapses: The declaration carries only the exact multiplicative unit relation, without measurement or clock-model errors.
conversion:si-brochure/hour-to-second.licenses: Convert fixed elapsed hours to seconds by 3600 and use existing inverse lookup, with no offset, error or constant.
conversion:si-brochure/hour-to-second.not_established: Calendar conversion, clock calibration, period-to-frequency transformation and empirical measurement equivalence are not established.

quantity-kind:si-brochure/duration.collapses: The local name and T:1 vector encode only interval time; clock realization and offset origin remain with the consumer.
quantity-kind:si-brochure/duration.licenses: Elapsed intervals and signed differences under the time role; the Brochure supplies the second/time association, not this local quantity-kind wording.
quantity-kind:si-brochure/duration.not_established: Civil/calendar periods, UTC-to-elapsed mapping, clock calibration and empirical reuse standing are not established.

quantity-kind:si-brochure/frequency.collapses: The T:-1 vector retains periodic frequency for sampling clocks and Fourier coordinates, not every inverse-time quantity.
quantity-kind:si-brochure/frequency.licenses: Periodic frequency associated with hertz under the frequency role.
quantity-kind:si-brochure/frequency.not_established: Generic incidence, angular frequency, a periodic observed process or empirical standing is not established.

unit:si-brochure/hertz.collapses: The unit retains periodic frequency and does not collapse other inverse-time quantities.
unit:si-brochure/hertz.licenses: Hertz for the admitted frequency encoding with complete UCUM Hz and QUDT HZ mappings.
unit:si-brochure/hertz.not_established: Angular frequency, stochastic incidence and cycles-per-sample without a physical sampling grid are not licensed.

unit:si-brochure/hour.collapses: The unit fixes 3600 elapsed seconds and omits civil time-zone/calendar rules.
unit:si-brochure/hour.licenses: Fixed elapsed-hour values and the admitted exact conversion to seconds; UCUM h and QUDT HR identify the same unit.
unit:si-brochure/hour.not_established: A daylight-saving or civil/calendar hour is not guaranteed to be 3600 elapsed seconds; empirical standing is not established.

unit:si-brochure/second.collapses: A named unit abstracts over realization and measurement particulars.
unit:si-brochure/second.licenses: The SI second with complete pinned UCUM s and QUDT SEC unit mappings, restricted here to the duration encoding.
unit:si-brochure/second.not_established: Clock realization, synchronization, elapsed-time reconstruction and empirical measurement validity are not certified.
